Thanks! I creeped through your submissions and saw the plasti dip stripes. I have been thinking about plasti dipping some boss-like stripes that start on the hood and wrap around to the side. Any suggestions?

Do your research. Plasti-dip can be a pain to peel if not done correctly. My stripes were not painted on with the right consistency. So when I peeled it, it did not peel clean. I just got a pressure washer and stripped it right off no problem. Make sure you leave enough time between coats.

90% of the time spent painting is actually taping and measuring. Take your time and you will love the results. Same with spraying. Consistency is the best way to think. Proper spray height and consistent coats will really make a difference.

Try to get your dip from Home Depot or a surplus store. Its like 2 bucks a can at HD. Compared to Lowes which is about 7 or 8 a can. Get spray handles! Keep the car clean and spray in the shade.

Best part about Dip, you can practice. If you dont like it....peel it!
